root_cause: Portal V2 already contained most strategic, scenario, M&A, execution and evidence capabilities and Scale already had the operational entitlements for forecasting, scenario analysis, approvals, audit trail, 15 sources and hourly refresh. The missing layer was a canonical company-lifecycle context that connected growth, loss/recovery, acute continuity, buy-side, sell-side and portfolio situations to the relevant Brain models, portal pages, decisions, evidence and actions.
prevention_rule: New commercial lifecycle propositions must not remain website-only. Every material company stage or buyer context must be represented in the Powerhouse Brain context contract, projected into decision/executive context, exposed in Portal V2, connected to relevant models/pages/actions/evidence, and covered by canonical brain plus portal tests. Core intelligence workspaces remain available across paid plans; tiers differ by scale, freshness, automation, governance and advisory envelope.

evidence.outcome: Powerhouse and Portal V2 share lifecycle semantics for growth, recovery, continuity, M&A and portfolio contexts; Scale exposes the full intelligence workspace while retaining its operational envelope.
